examples.en: Consumer lending lives on thin margins and precise risk models.
examples.zh: 消费信贷靠的是薄利和精确的风险模型。

situation.en: I spent two years building internal platforms for a consumer lending company.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 消费信贷（面向个人的小额贷款业务）

examples.en: The credit line grows only after a clean repayment history.
examples.zh: 授信额度只有在还款记录干净之后才会涨。

situation.en: We set the initial credit line conservatively and raise it with behavior.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 授信额度（批给用户的可借上限）

examples.en: Credit assessment pulls bureau data, income, and device signals.
examples.zh: 信用评估会拉征信数据、收入和设备信号。

situation.en: Our credit assessment runs in under a second for most applicants.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 信用评估（决定批不批、批多少）

examples.en: Creditworthiness is a probability, not a moral judgment.
examples.zh: 信用资质是一个概率，不是一种道德评判。

situation.en: The score estimates creditworthiness; the policy decides the cutoff.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 信用资质（值不值得借钱给他）

examples.en: Risk scoring blends application data with repayment history.
examples.zh: 风险评分把申请数据和还款历史混合起来算。

situation.en: Risk scoring happens before underwriting, not instead of it.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 风险评分（给申请人打风险分）

examples.en: Risk control is the product in lending; the app is just the doorway.
examples.zh: 在借贷业务里，风控就是产品本身；应用只是入口。

situation.en: On the platform team I worked closest with the risk control group.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 风险控制、风控

examples.en: Underwriting combines automated rules with manual review for edge cases.
examples.zh: 审批环节把自动规则和边缘案例的人工复核结合起来。

situation.en: Straight-through underwriting approves clean applications without a human.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 核保/审批（决定贷款是否通过的环节）

examples.en: Loan approval is a decision the system must explain afterwards.
examples.zh: 贷款审批通过是一个系统事后必须能解释的决定。

situation.en: Every loan approval writes its rule hits into the audit trail.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 贷款审批通过

examples.en: Loan disbursement happens only after the contract is signed in-app.
examples.zh: 放款只在应用内签完合同之后发生。

situation.en: Disbursement failures are worse than approval delays: the user was promised money.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 放款（把钱打到用户账户）

examples.en: Delinquency is measured in buckets: one day, thirty, sixty, ninety.
examples.zh: 逾期按桶来度量：一天、三十天、六十天、九十天。

situation.en: Early delinquency signals feed the collections queue, not the blacklist.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 逾期（未按期还款的状态）

examples.en: The default rate, not the approval rate, decides whether the product survives.
examples.zh: 决定产品生死的是违约率，不是审批通过率。

situation.en: We watch default rate by acquisition channel, because quality differs wildly.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 违约率（最终还不上的比例）

examples.en: Debt collection is regulated down to the wording of a text message.
examples.zh: 催收被监管到一条短信的措辞。

situation.en: Our platform schedules collection contacts and records every touch for compliance.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 催收（追讨逾期欠款）

examples.en: The repayment schedule must survive payday moving by a week.
examples.zh: 还款计划必须经得起发薪日挪动一周。

situation.en: Users see the full repayment schedule before they confirm the loan.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 还款计划（每期还多少、何时还）

examples.en: An installment plan splits the purchase into monthly payments.
examples.zh: 分期计划把一笔消费拆成每月还款。

situation.en: The installment plan is chosen at checkout, not after the bill arrives.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 分期计划

examples.en: The annual percentage rate includes fees, so it beats the headline rate for honesty.
examples.zh: 年化利率包含费用，所以它比宣传利率更诚实。

situation.en: Regulators require the annual percentage rate in the same font size as the offer.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 年化利率（APR，含费用的真实年利率）

examples.en: Prepayment is free on this product; the penalty exists only in the older one.
examples.zh: 这个产品提前还款免费；罚金只存在于老产品里。

situation.en: Prepayment behavior is itself a signal in the risk model.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 提前还款

examples.en: Unsecured lending prices risk without collateral to fall back on.
examples.zh: 无抵押借贷在定价风险时没有抵押物兜底。

situation.en: With collateral, the loss given default drops; without it, scoring carries everything.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 抵押物

examples.en: A guarantor signs only after seeing the same repayment schedule.
examples.zh: 担保人只有在看过同一份还款计划后才签字。

situation.en: The guarantor flow needs its own consent and identity checks.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 担保人

examples.en: Identity verification combines document checks with a live selfie.
examples.zh: 身份核验把证件检查和活体自拍结合起来。

situation.en: Most application drop-off happens at identity verification, so we instrument it heavily.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 身份核验（确认申请人是本人）

examples.en: Know your customer checks are a legal gate, not a UX preference.
examples.zh: 了解你的客户审查是一道法律关卡，不是体验偏好。

situation.en: KYC — know your customer — is where our onboarding funnel starts.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 了解你的客户（KYC，金融合规的身份审查）

examples.en: Anti-money laundering monitoring watches patterns, not single transactions.
examples.zh: 反洗钱监控盯的是模式，不是单笔交易。

situation.en: The anti-money laundering rules flag structuring: many small transfers just under the limit.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 反洗钱（AML）

examples.en: A fraud ring reuses devices and addresses across hundreds of applications.
examples.zh: 欺诈团伙会在几百份申请里复用设备和地址。

situation.en: Graph features expose a fraud ring that per-application rules miss.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 欺诈团伙（有组织的造假申请网络）

examples.en: Account takeover spikes after every external password leak.
examples.zh: 每次外部密码泄漏之后，账户盗用都会飙升。

situation.en: We added step-up verification after an account takeover wave.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 账户盗用（攻击者接管用户账户）

examples.en: Transaction monitoring scores every transfer before it settles.
examples.zh: 交易监控在每笔转账结算之前给它打分。

situation.en: Transaction monitoring must decide in milliseconds, so the rules stay shallow.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 交易监控（实时盯异常交易）

examples.en: Risk-based pricing charges the riskiest borrowers the highest rates.
examples.zh: 风险定价让风险最高的借款人付最高的利率。

situation.en: Risk-based pricing is fair only if the score itself is fair.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 风险定价（风险越高利率越高）

examples.en: The credit bureau report is one input, not the verdict.
examples.zh: 征信机构的报告是一个输入，不是判决。

situation.en: We query the credit bureau once per application and cache the result.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 征信机构

examples.en: Users can dispute errors on their credit report, and many should.
examples.zh: 用户可以对征信报告上的错误提出异议，而且很多人都应该这样做。

situation.en: A thin credit report is not a bad one; the model must know the difference.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 征信报告

examples.en: The debt-to-income ratio caps how much new credit the system offers.
examples.zh: 负债收入比给系统能批的新额度封了顶。

situation.en: We compute the debt-to-income ratio from verified income, not self-reported.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 负债收入比

examples.en: Loan origination is the funnel: application, assessment, approval, disbursement.
examples.zh: 贷款发起就是那个漏斗：申请、评估、审批、放款。

situation.en: I worked on the loan origination platform end to end.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 贷款发起（从申请到放款的全流程）

examples.en: Loan servicing starts where origination ends: statements, payments, support.
examples.zh: 贷款服务期管理从发起结束的地方开始：账单、还款、客服。

situation.en: Most user contacts happen in loan servicing, not during application.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 贷款服务期管理（放款后的还款与客服）

examples.en: A charge-off happens after 180 days and failed collection.
examples.zh: 核销发生在逾期 180 天且催收失败之后。

situation.en: Charge-off timing is accounting policy, not a button engineers press.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 核销（确认收不回、从账上划掉）

examples.en: A write-off closes the books on a loan, not the legal claim.
examples.zh: 坏账冲销关上的是账本，不是法律追索权。

situation.en: Write-off rates by cohort tell you which month's underwriting slipped.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 坏账冲销（同核销的常用说法）

examples.en: The provision for losses is set aside before the defaults arrive.
examples.zh: 损失拨备是在违约到来之前就预留出来的。

situation.en: Finance owns the provision for losses; we just supply the forecasts.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 损失拨备（提前预留的坏账准备金）

examples.en: Capital adequacy rules decide how fast a lender may grow.
examples.zh: 资本充足率的规则决定一家放贷机构能长多快。

situation.en: Growth plans in lending always answer to capital adequacy.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 资本充足率（扛风险的本钱够不够）

examples.en: Regulatory compliance shapes the data model more than user needs do.
examples.zh: 监管合规对数据模型的塑造比用户需求还大。

situation.en: In fintech, regulatory compliance is a feature, not paperwork after the fact.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 监管合规

examples.en: Every approval decision keeps an audit trail for regulators.
examples.zh: 每个审批决定都为监管保留审计轨迹。

situation.en: The audit trail is append-only; even admins cannot edit it.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 审计轨迹（谁在何时改了什么的完整记录）

examples.en: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest and masked in every internal tool.
examples.zh: 敏感数据静态加密，在每个内部工具里都脱敏显示。

situation.en: Access to sensitive data is logged, justified, and reviewed monthly.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 敏感数据（身份证、银行卡等）

examples.en: Consent management records what the user agreed to, and when they revoked it.
examples.zh: 授权管理记录用户同意了什么、又在何时撤回。

situation.en: Our consent management had to survive a full regulatory audit.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 授权管理（用户同意的记录与撤回）

examples.en: The cooling-off period lets a borrower cancel within twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 冷静期让借款人在二十四小时内可以无条件取消。

situation.en: The cooling-off period must be visible before signing, not buried in terms.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 冷静期（签约后可无条件取消的期限）

examples.en: Restructuring a loan beats pushing a struggling borrower into default.
examples.zh: 给困难用户做贷款重组，比把他推进违约要好。

situation.en: The hardship flow is basically restructuring a loan with dignity.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 贷款重组（给困难用户调整还款安排）

examples.en: A hardship program pauses payments for borrowers who lose income.
examples.zh: 困难帮扶计划为失去收入的借款人暂停还款。

situation.en: Building the hardship program taught me the servicing side of the business.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 困难帮扶计划（失业生病时的减免安排）

examples.en: A settlement offer closes an old debt for less than the full amount.
examples.zh: 和解方案让一笔旧债以低于全额的价格结清。

situation.en: Settlement offers are calculated per segment, never improvised by agents.
situation.zh: 你在和风控同事对齐需求时这样说：

entries.zh: 和解方案（打折一次性结清欠款）

examples.en: A payment reminder three days before the due date cuts late payments noticeably.
examples.zh: 到期前三天的还款提醒能显著减少逾期。

situation.en: The wording of the payment reminder is reviewed by compliance, like everything user-facing.
situation.zh: 评审信贷系统设计时你这样说：

entries.zh: 还款提醒

examples.en: The overdue notice must state the amount, the days, and the way out.
examples.zh: 逾期通知必须写明金额、天数和解决办法。

situation.en: We A/B tested the overdue notice tone; firm and respectful won.
situation.zh: 面试官问你消费金融项目的细节，你回答：

entries.zh: 逾期通知
